What our users say

Reviews of HobbyMatch® that people have posted on the App Store, Google Play and Trustpilot, newest first. Each one links to where it was posted.

No reviews to show yet. If you use HobbyMatch, you can leave an honest review on the App Store, good or bad.

Our reviews policy

  • We only show real reviews that people posted publicly, copied exactly as written, with a link to the original.
  • We don't write, buy or swap anything for reviews, and we don't offer rewards for leaving one.
  • We show negative reviews as well as positive ones. We don't pick only the good ones, and we don't ask only happy users to review us.
  • The app may ask you once in a while whether you'd like to leave a review, using Apple's and Google's own rating prompt. Everyone sees the same prompt, whatever they think of the app.

Think a review here breaks these rules? Email support@hobbymatch.fit.
